units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. An intimate close-up at the museum display glass; her head and shoulders fill the frame exactly as in the first frame and the camera holds perfectly still. A young woman with a dark fringe stands in profile facing the vitrine, warm tungsten halogen at 3000K raking the near side of her face, the carved stone relief dimly reflected in the glass at the left edge, everything else falling to warm black. Her head stays in the same profile angle, chin level, jaw relaxed, her lips stay together and closed, and only her eyes and eyelids move: at the start her eyes travel slowly along one carved line reflected in the glass, around one second her eyelids close once and open again over about seven frames, and after that her gaze lifts a little toward her own faint reflection in the glass where it settles. Near the end her shoulders settle as she lets one breath out. Fine 35mm grain, warm halation along the glass edge, black point slightly lifted, warm natural skin, the same hall and the same lighting as the first frame.
